notes.tab01Precondition: TAB 01 states its precondition as 'a running backend to observe, not merely a document to read'. No staging API exists and no Postgres runs on this machine; TAB 01 proceeds against the repository as the source of observed truth (route:list, openapi.json, conventions.md, config/cors.php, the real generators), and every acceptance criterion needing a live call is recorded as environmentally deferred.
